text: {"C1":{"score":10,"justification":"Opening includes company name, agent's own name, and an offer of help, all within the first line.","evidence":"Gracias por llamar a Seguros Confianza, le atiende Gabriela Meraz. Le comento que esta llamada puede ser grabada para calidad. ¿En qué le puedo servir?"},"C2":{"score":10,"justification":"Agent probed the reason for cancellation, pulled the policy, compared competitor coverages, and confirmed understanding before proposing a solution.","evidence":"Antes de procesarlo, ¿me permite entender qué lo lleva a cancelar? ... ¿La cotización que le dieron incluye cristales y auto sustituto como la suya?"},"C3":{"score":10,"justification":"Recording disclosure was delivered in the opening line and no prohibited statements appear; the price given is an applied adjustment to an existing policy, not a binding pre-underwriting quote.","evidence":"Le comento que esta llamada puede ser grabada para calidad."},"C4":{"score":10,"justification":"The customer's reason for calling was fully resolved (retained with adjusted premium) and a concrete next step with owner and timeframe was set.","evidence":"Ya apliqué el descuento y el ajuste, su próximo cargo del día primero ya sale con el monto nuevo de mil ciento ochenta. Hoy antes de las seis de la tarde le llega el correo de confirmación con el detalle."},"C5":{"score":10,"justification":"Agent was courteous throughout, let the customer speak, respected his right to cancel, and kept the call focused and on track.","evidence":"Pero la decisión es completamente suya, si prefiere cancelar lo hacemos sin problema."}}
